name: wakeshift
description: Lets Wakeshift messages wake your Claude Code sessions, even while they're idle, for the apps you connect. Its hooks run Wakeshift's connector, ~/.wakeshift/bin/wakeshift, which it downloads and checks against the SHA-256 it carries.

issuer.title: Wakeshift server
issuer.description: The Wakeshift whose messages may wake your sessions: https://app.wakeshift.ai unless you use another
